jobs.title: Chief People and Culture Officer
jobs.description:
Omnisage LLC, a pioneering force in the Artificial Intelligence & ML sector and the company behind Scovai — an AI-powered talent acquisition platform — is seeking a visionary Chief People and Culture Officer to join its executive leadership team. This is a rare opportunity to shape the human foundation of a fast-scaling AI company from the ground up, partnering directly with the CEO to build world-class teams, define organizational culture, and architect the people strategy that will power both Omnisage and the Scovai platform through its next phase of growth.

As CPCO, you will own the full spectrum of people operations: designing and executing HR transformation strategies, leading talent acquisition and retention initiatives tailored to the competitive AI and tech landscape, and building a culture of innovation, inclusion, and high performance. You will drive organizational design as the company scales, implement robust performance management systems, and lead leadership development and C-suite coaching programs. Your expertise in change management will be critical as Omnisage evolves rapidly, and your familiarity with AI-powered recruiting tools will position you to leverage Scovai's own capabilities internally.

This role is as exciting as it is impactful — you will be a true co-architect of Omnisage's identity, embedding people-first thinking into every layer of the business. If you thrive at the intersection of technology, strategy, and human potential, and are energized by the challenge of building something extraordinary in one of the world's most dynamic markets, this is your moment.

jobs.title: VP, People Operations Manager - Global Payroll & HRIS
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.

What We Value

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

Seek Excellence.
Be Selective To Be Effective.
Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.
Disagree Transparently.
Encourage Independent Decision-Making.
Build Dream Teams.

Who You Are

Galaxy is seeking a People Operations Manager, Global Payroll & HRIS to join our People team in a hands-on, execution-focused role supporting our global workforce. This position will initially join on a temporary-to-permanent basis and will play a critical role in two key areas: global payroll operations and the implementation of Workday, with a targeted go-live date of January 1, 2027. In your first three-six months, success will mean helping Galaxy deliver a clean and well-controlled Workday go-live, ensuring payroll readiness and data integrity, and establishing scalable processes that can transition into steady-state People Operations

Leading up to go-live, this individual will partner closely with People, Payroll, Finance, Technology, external implementation partners, and other key stakeholders to support the successful implementation of Workday. This will include data validation and migration, business process design, testing, integrations, payroll readiness, documentation, and change management.

At the same time, this person will help manage and strengthen Galaxy's global payroll operations, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time and that payroll processes, controls, data, and vendor relationships can scale with the organization.

Following implementation, the role will transition toward ongoing ownership and optimization of Workday and global payroll operations, including system administration, data integrity, reporting, process improvement, controls, and the employee experience.

We're looking for someone who enjoys being close to the details while understanding the broader operational picture - someone who can identify an issue in a payroll reconciliation or employee record, work cross-functionally to resolve it, and then improve the underlying process so it doesn't happen again.

What You’ll Do

Workday Implementation & HRIS
Serve as a key People Operations partner for Galaxy's Workday implementation ahead of the January 1, 2027 go-live.
Partner with internal stakeholders and external implementation resources to support requirements gathering, business process design, system configuration, integrations, and implementation activities.
Coordinate and execute data preparation, cleansing, validation, and migration activities to ensure accurate employee and payroll data within Workday
Develop and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), document results, identify issues, and partner with appropriate stakeholders through resolution.
Support payroll parallel testing and other payroll-readiness activities ahead of go-live.
Help establish scalable HRIS processes, controls, documentation, and governance.
Develop process documentation, SOPs, training materials, and resources for People team members, managers, and employees.
Support change management, training, and communications associated with the Workday launch.
Following go-live, help manage ongoing Workday administration, including business processes, employee data, reporting, security/access, system updates, and issue resolution.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve, automate, and scale People processes through Workday and other technologies.

Global Payroll
Support the end-to-end administration of payroll across Galaxy's global employee population, partnering with internal teams and third-party payroll providers as appropriate.
Review payroll inputs and outputs to ensure employees are paid accurately, completely, and on time.
Perform payroll audits, reconciliations, and variance analyses and proactively investigate and resolve discrepancies.
Coordinate employee lifecycle changes impacting payroll, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, benefits deductions, leaves, and other employee changes.
Partner with Finance on payroll funding, reconciliations, reporting, and related accounting requirements.
Work with People team partners to ensure HRIS, payroll, benefits, and employee data remain aligned across systems and vendors.
Support payroll compliance requirements across applicable jurisdictions and partner with internal and external subject-matter experts as needed.
Manage day-to-day relationships with payroll vendors, escalating and resolving issues while holding partners accountable for service and accuracy.
Maintain payroll calendars, controls, documentation, and standard operating procedures.
Identify opportunities to standardize and strengthen global payroll processes as Galaxy continues to grow.

People Operations
Maintain a high standard of employee data accuracy and integrity across People systems.
Produce and analyze People and payroll data to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for operational improvement.
Support employee inquiries related to payroll, HR systems, and People processes, providing a high level of service and discretion.
Partner cross-functionally across People, Finance, Legal, Technology, and other teams on projects affecting employee data and operations.
Support audits, compliance requests, reporting, and other People Operations initiatives as needed.
Handle highly sensitive and confidential employee information with sound judgment and discretion.
Support global payroll operations across multiple jurisdictions (e.g., US, UK, Ireland, Portugal, and EOR-supported countries), including timesheet approvals, payroll data prep, and coordination with in-country payroll vendors.
Assist with new hire onboarding, employee data changes, transfers, and offboarding processes within Workday and related HR systems.
Prepare reports, reconciliations, and ad hoc analyses to support payroll and people operations initiatives.
Help document processes and maintain SOPs for HRIS, payroll, and people operations workflows.
Respond to employee and manager inquiries related to payroll, HR data, and system access with a high level of accuracy and discretion.

What We’re Looking For

6+ years of relevant experience in People Operations, payroll, HRIS, HR technology, or a related field.
Hands-on experience supporting payroll operations; global or multi-country payroll experience strongly preferred.
Experience working with Workday or another enterprise HRIS; direct Workday implementation experience is strongly preferred.
Experience participating in an HRIS implementation, migration, configuration, or significant system transformation is highly desirable.
Strong understanding of the connection between HRIS data, payroll, benefits, Finance, and employee lifecycle processes.
Demonstrated ability to reconcile complex datasets, identify discrepancies, and drive issues through resolution.
Strong Excel skills and comfort working with large datasets, reporting, and analysis.
Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive workstreams simultaneously.
Strong project management skills and the ability to keep deliverables moving across multiple stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where processes may still be evolving.
Takes ownership, works effectively both independently and collaboratively, and knows when to escalate issues.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical or operational issues for different audiences.
Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive employee and compensation information.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Bonus Points

Experience with a Workday HCM and/or Payroll implementation, particularly involving a January 1 or year-start cutover.
Experience supporting payroll across North America, EMEA, and/or APAC.
Experience working with multiple local payroll providers or a global payroll platform.
Familiarity with payroll integrations, data feeds, benefits integrations, and Finance/GL processes.
Experience developing UAT scripts, executing parallel payroll testing, or supporting system cutovers.
Experience building or improving payroll controls, SOPs, and audit processes.
Experience in a high-growth, global financial services or technology organization.

What We Offer

Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus
Hybrid/Flexible Working Arrangements
Flexible Time Off (paid)
3% 401(k) company contribution
Company-paid health and protective benefits for employees, partners, and other dependents
Generous paid Parental Leave
Competitive family planning benefits for US employees
Opportunities to learn about the Crypto industry
Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues
Free daily snacks and weekly breakfasts/lunches
Employee Resource Groups
Free coaching and counseling sessions through Headspace

Apply now and join us as we grow the economy that runs on code.

The base salary ranges included below will be commensurate with candidate experience, expertise and local market. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise. At Galaxy, we maintain a total compensation philosophy which consists of a competitive base salary, annual bonus, and equity incentives.

Base Salary Range

$130,000 - $150,000 USD

jobs.description:
Job Title- HR Manager- Compensation/ Payroll 
Location: 1-2 Days Onsite
Type : Full Time
Industry- Financial
Salary: $110K-$120K

Position Summary:

The HR Manager is responsible for administering key human resources functions, with primary accountability for benefits, multi-state payroll, compensation, and training. This role works closely with the VP of Human Resources and leadership to support a compliant, efficient, and employee-centered workplace by ensuring HR programs, processes, and day-to-day activities are carried out accurately and effectively. The ideal candidate brings strong operational HR experience, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a changing environment.
Key Responsibilities

HR Operations:
Process payroll to ensure timely and accurate payroll administration, deductions, reconciliations, and compliance with applicable laws and internal controls.
Serve as a resource to employees and managers on HR policies, benefits, payroll, compensation, and workplace practices.
Prepare HR reports, audits, and analysis related to benefits, payroll, compensation, training, and other workforce metrics.
Manage HR systems and data to ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and timely reporting.
Administer employee benefits programs, including enrollment, changes, open enrollment coordination, vendor communication, and employee education.
Administer retirement plans, including 401(a), 403(b), and 457(b), by processing transactions, coordinating with vendors, and responding to employee questions.
Serve as the Local Plan Administrator by maintaining plan records, coordinating required actions, and supporting retirement plan administration activities.

Compensation and Data Insights Management:
Support compensation administration, including salary reviews, market pricing, job evaluations, pay changes, incentive administration, and maintenance of compensation data.
Tracks HR metrics and analyzes trends in compensation, turnover, and engagement to guide strategic decisions.
Supports VP of HR in the preparation of compensation-related materials, data, and supporting analysis for Executive Leadership and Compensation Committee meetings.
Support performance management activities, employee relations matters, and workplace investigations as needed, including documentation, follow-up, and coordination.
Assist with HR-related budget preparation by compiling data, tracking costs, and supporting the annual budgeting process.

Compliance
Maintain and update HR policies, procedures, records, and documentation in compliance with federal, state, and local employment requirements.
Support compliance activities, including required notices, filings, audits, and response to regulatory changes.
Perform other related duties as assigned.
Prepare and provide HR data and documentation for Form 990, workers’ compensation audits, and other regulatory or audit requests.

Talent Management & Culture:
Coordinate full-cycle recruiting and onboarding activities, including posting jobs, scheduling interviews, preparing offer and onboarding materials, and supporting new hire setup.
Administer day-to-day talent management activities, including performance review administration, tracking development plans, supporting talent review meetings, and maintaining related documentation.
Work closely with managers to address day-to-day employee matters, reinforce workplace expectations, and support a positive and productive work environment.
Coordinate and support employee engagement, recognition, and retention activities, including communications, event planning, feedback collection, and follow-up actions.
Provide practical support to managers on employee development, team issues, and routine workplace concerns, and help ensure consistent follow-through on action items.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 7+ years of progressive human resources experience, including direct experience in benefits, payroll, compensation, and training and development.
Working knowledge of applicable federal, multi-state, and local employment laws and regulations.
Experience administering HRIS, payroll, and benefits systems.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy and attention to detail.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About The Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About The Role

A highly organized and proactive People Operations Manager to build and scale the processes, systems, and programs that underpin our people experience. As a company operating in the rapidly evolving stablecoin and digital asset space, we move quickly while maintaining high standards of compliance, precision, and trust. The People Operations Manager will ensure our HR infrastructure is robust, efficient, and compliant across all regions in which we operate.

This role sits at the intersection of HR, legal, compliance, recruiting, payroll, and finance—requiring someone who is detail-oriented, tech-savvy, and comfortable working in a dynamic, regulated environment.

What You’ll Do

Own and optimize our HRIS, ATS, and people operations tools; drive automation and workflow improvements
Maintain accurate employee data, organizational charts, and reporting lines across all systems
Lead data integrity, auditing, and compliance efforts across HR platforms.
People Processes & Compliance
Develop, document, and maintain HR policies, handbooks, and SOPs across global jurisdictions
Ensure compliance with employment laws, financial regulatory requirements, and crypto-industry standards
Partner with Legal and Compliance to support onboarding, offboarding, and employee lifecycle changes
Manage background checks, employment verifications, and contractor compliance processes
International & Domestic Compensation, Payroll & Benefits Coordination
Collaborate with Finance and external payroll providers to ensure timely, accurate global payroll
Maintain records for variable compensation, token/equity grants, and other crypto-specific programs
Support annual compensation reviews, benefits renewals, and compensation benchmarking efforts
Employee Experience & Lifecycle Management
Manage onboarding workflows to ensure a smooth, compliant, and high-quality new-hire experience
Oversee offboarding, exit documentation, equipment logistics, and system access governance
Serve as the first point of contact for HR inquiries, troubleshooting and escalating as needed.
Reporting & Analytics
Build and maintain dashboards for headcount, attrition, diversity metrics, workforce planning, and more
Provide people data insights to leadership for strategic planning and audits

What we're looking for

5+ years of HR operations or people operations experience, ideally within fintech, crypto, or tech
Deep understanding of global HR compliance, employment laws, and payroll operations
Experience managing HR systems (e.g., Ashby, Notion, JustWorks)
Strong analytical mindset and comfort with spreadsheets, audits, and data integrity
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to scale processes in a fast-moving environment
Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, fintech, banking, crypto) strongly preferred
Discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive information

Nice to have, but not mandatory

Experience supporting teams across the US, LATAM, EU, or APAC
Familiarity with compensation structures unique to crypto (token grants, vesting schedules)
Background in startup environments or early-stage company scaling

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy, and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off
🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working
☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits
🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals
💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan
📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness
📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals
🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits
✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Compensation Range: $120K - $160K

jobs.title: Sr. Manager Talent Acquisition
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Smurfit Westrock (NYSE:SW) is the go-to leader and partner of choice in sustainable packaging. We are dedicated to creating efficient and scalable paper and packaging solutions to help solve complex packaging challenges. Guided by our values of safety, loyalty, integrity and respect, we are committed to delivering meaningful value for shareholders, customers, employees and the communities where we operate.

The Sr. Manager, Talent Acquisition will be an essential leader within the Frontline Talent Acquisition team and will be responsible for leading recruitment efforts across the Corrugated Division to include Merchandising Display & Packaging Solutions. In this role, you will design and execute Frontline Talent Acquisition strategies that attract top hourly and Salary Non-Exempt talent and support organizational growth. You will partner closely with HR and business leaders to ensure alignment with workforce planning and deliver a world-class hiring manager and candidate experience. This position offers the opportunity to influence global recruiting practices, mentor teams, and drive impactful initiatives.

How You Will Impact Smurfit Westrock

Provide strategic leadership and direction to a team of recruiters, ensuring alignment with business objectives, operational excellence, and industry best practices.
Design, implement, and continuously optimize enterprise level recruiting strategies that accelerate hiring speed, elevate talent quality, strengthen workforce diversity, and enhance the end-to-end candidate experience.
Work in conjunction with peers and leadership to develop, implement, and continuously enhance standardized operating procedures for Talent Acquisition processes, while training and coaching team members to ensure consistent execution, compliance, and operational excellence.
Partner closely with HR Business Partners and senior business leaders to understand workforce planning needs and deliver proactive, data informed talent solutions.
Serve as a trusted external labor market expert, advising executives on talent supply trends, competitive intelligence, and sourcing strategies that support long term talent pipeline development.
Lead employer brand initiatives to position Smurfit WestRock as a top employer of choice across priority markets and talent segments.
Ensure full compliance with all employment laws, regulatory requirements, and internal policies across the recruiting lifecycle, mitigating risk and promoting equitable hiring practices.
Collaborate with TA Operations, HR Technology, and TA leadership to evaluate, implement, and optimize recruitment technologies, tools, and workflows that enhance efficiency and stakeholder engagement.
Leverage recruiting analytics and performance metrics to identify trends, diagnose challenges, and drive continuous improvement across processes, team performance, and hiring outcomes.
Influence and consult with senior stakeholders through data-driven recommendations, reinforcing Talent Acquisition best practices and enabling effective decision-making.
Oversee the full recruitment lifecycle for critical or executive-level roles, including intake strategy sessions, interview design, talent assessment, and post-interview debrief facilitation.
Lead or contribute to strategic initiatives and enterprise-wide projects aimed at strengthening Talent Acquisition capabilities, processes, and organizational readiness.

What You Need To Succeed

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, or related field.
10+ years of corporate recruiting or talent acquisition experience; leadership experience required.
Proven experience developing and leading recruitment strategies for high volume hourly and skilled trade roles, with strong preference for candidates with production and manufacturing environment experience.
Strong business acumen to build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with business leaders and HR Business Partners, serving as a strategic talent partner to align hiring strategies with business priorities and workforce needs.
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make strategic recommendations.
Exceptional communication and influencing skills to engage stakeholders and candidates.
Experience recruiting across multiple levels and functions (professional, technical, leadership).
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

What Smurfit Westrock Offers

Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
Retirement savings plans with company match.
Paid time off and holiday benefits.
Wellness programs and employee assistance resources.
Career development opportunities and leadership training.
Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability, and excellence.
A career with a global packaging leader where sustainability, safety, and inclusion are core values.

Candidates are required to undergo a drug screening after receiving a conditional job offer, but before starting employment.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law.

At the same time, this person will help manage and strengthen Galaxy's global payroll operations, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time and that payroll processes, controls, data, and vendor relationships can scale with the organization.

Following implementation, the role will transition toward ongoing ownership and optimization of Workday and global payroll operations, including system administration, data integrity, reporting, process improvement, controls, and the employee experience.

We're looking for someone who enjoys being close to the details while understanding the broader operational picture - someone who can identify an issue in a payroll reconciliation or employee record, work cross-functionally to resolve it, and then improve the underlying process so it doesn't happen again.

What You’ll Do

Workday Implementation & HRIS
Serve as a key People Operations partner for Galaxy's Workday implementation ahead of the January 1, 2027 go-live.
Partner with internal stakeholders and external implementation resources to support requirements gathering, business process design, system configuration, integrations, and implementation activities.
Coordinate and execute data preparation, cleansing, validation, and migration activities to ensure accurate employee and payroll data within Workday
Develop and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), document results, identify issues, and partner with appropriate stakeholders through resolution.
Support payroll parallel testing and other payroll-readiness activities ahead of go-live.
Help establish scalable HRIS processes, controls, documentation, and governance.
Develop process documentation, SOPs, training materials, and resources for People team members, managers, and employees.
Support change management, training, and communications associated with the Workday launch.
Following go-live, help manage ongoing Workday administration, including business processes, employee data, reporting, security/access, system updates, and issue resolution.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve, automate, and scale People processes through Workday and other technologies.

Global Payroll
Support the end-to-end administration of payroll across Galaxy's global employee population, partnering with internal teams and third-party payroll providers as appropriate.
Review payroll inputs and outputs to ensure employees are paid accurately, completely, and on time.
Perform payroll audits, reconciliations, and variance analyses and proactively investigate and resolve discrepancies.
Coordinate employee lifecycle changes impacting payroll, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, benefits deductions, leaves, and other employee changes.
Partner with Finance on payroll funding, reconciliations, reporting, and related accounting requirements.
Work with People team partners to ensure HRIS, payroll, benefits, and employee data remain aligned across systems and vendors.
Support payroll compliance requirements across applicable jurisdictions and partner with internal and external subject-matter experts as needed.
Manage day-to-day relationships with payroll vendors, escalating and resolving issues while holding partners accountable for service and accuracy.
Maintain payroll calendars, controls, documentation, and standard operating procedures.
Identify opportunities to standardize and strengthen global payroll processes as Galaxy continues to grow.

People Operations
Maintain a high standard of employee data accuracy and integrity across People systems.
Produce and analyze People and payroll data to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for operational improvement.
Support employee inquiries related to payroll, HR systems, and People processes, providing a high level of service and discretion.
Partner cross-functionally across People, Finance, Legal, Technology, and other teams on projects affecting employee data and operations.
Support audits, compliance requests, reporting, and other People Operations initiatives as needed.
Handle highly sensitive and confidential employee information with sound judgment and discretion.
Support global payroll operations across multiple jurisdictions (e.g., US, UK, Ireland, Portugal, and EOR-supported countries), including timesheet approvals, payroll data prep, and coordination with in-country payroll vendors.
Assist with new hire onboarding, employee data changes, transfers, and offboarding processes within Workday and related HR systems.
Prepare reports, reconciliations, and ad hoc analyses to support payroll and people operations initiatives.
Help document processes and maintain SOPs for HRIS, payroll, and people operations workflows.
Respond to employee and manager inquiries related to payroll, HR data, and system access with a high level of accuracy and discretion.

What We’re Looking For

6+ years of relevant experience in People Operations, payroll, HRIS, HR technology, or a related field.
Hands-on experience supporting payroll operations; global or multi-country payroll experience strongly preferred.
Experience working with Workday or another enterprise HRIS; direct Workday implementation experience is strongly preferred.
Experience participating in an HRIS implementation, migration, configuration, or significant system transformation is highly desirable.
Strong understanding of the connection between HRIS data, payroll, benefits, Finance, and employee lifecycle processes.
Demonstrated ability to reconcile complex datasets, identify discrepancies, and drive issues through resolution.
Strong Excel skills and comfort working with large datasets, reporting, and analysis.
Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive workstreams simultaneously.
Strong project management skills and the ability to keep deliverables moving across multiple stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where processes may still be evolving.
Takes ownership, works effectively both independently and collaboratively, and knows when to escalate issues.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical or operational issues for different audiences.
Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive employee and compensation information.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Bonus Points

Experience with a Workday HCM and/or Payroll implementation, particularly involving a January 1 or year-start cutover.
Experience supporting payroll across North America, EMEA, and/or APAC.
Experience working with multiple local payroll providers or a global payroll platform.
Familiarity with payroll integrations, data feeds, benefits integrations, and Finance/GL processes.
Experience developing UAT scripts, executing parallel payroll testing, or supporting system cutovers.
Experience building or improving payroll controls, SOPs, and audit processes.
Experience in a high-growth, global financial services or technology organization.

What We Offer

Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus
Hybrid/Flexible Working Arrangements
Flexible Time Off (paid)
3% 401(k) company contribution
Company-paid health and protective benefits for employees, partners, and other dependents
Generous paid Parental Leave
Competitive family planning benefits for US employees
Opportunities to learn about the Crypto industry
Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues
Free daily snacks and weekly breakfasts/lunches
Employee Resource Groups
Free coaching and counseling sessions through Headspace

Apply now and join us as we grow the economy that runs on code.

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise. At Galaxy, we maintain a total compensation philosophy which consists of a competitive base salary, annual bonus, and equity incentives.

Position Summary:

The HR Manager is responsible for administering key human resources functions, with primary accountability for benefits, multi-state payroll, compensation, and training. This role works closely with the VP of Human Resources and leadership to support a compliant, efficient, and employee-centered workplace by ensuring HR programs, processes, and day-to-day activities are carried out accurately and effectively. The ideal candidate brings strong operational HR experience, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a changing environment.
Key Responsibilities

HR Operations:
Process payroll to ensure timely and accurate payroll administration, deductions, reconciliations, and compliance with applicable laws and internal controls.
Serve as a resource to employees and managers on HR policies, benefits, payroll, compensation, and workplace practices.
Prepare HR reports, audits, and analysis related to benefits, payroll, compensation, training, and other workforce metrics.
Manage HR systems and data to ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and timely reporting.
Administer employee benefits programs, including enrollment, changes, open enrollment coordination, vendor communication, and employee education.
Administer retirement plans, including 401(a), 403(b), and 457(b), by processing transactions, coordinating with vendors, and responding to employee questions.
Serve as the Local Plan Administrator by maintaining plan records, coordinating required actions, and supporting retirement plan administration activities.

Compensation and Data Insights Management:
Support compensation administration, including salary reviews, market pricing, job evaluations, pay changes, incentive administration, and maintenance of compensation data.
Tracks HR metrics and analyzes trends in compensation, turnover, and engagement to guide strategic decisions.
Supports VP of HR in the preparation of compensation-related materials, data, and supporting analysis for Executive Leadership and Compensation Committee meetings.
Support performance management activities, employee relations matters, and workplace investigations as needed, including documentation, follow-up, and coordination.
Assist with HR-related budget preparation by compiling data, tracking costs, and supporting the annual budgeting process.

Compliance
Maintain and update HR policies, procedures, records, and documentation in compliance with federal, state, and local employment requirements.
Support compliance activities, including required notices, filings, audits, and response to regulatory changes.
Perform other related duties as assigned.
Prepare and provide HR data and documentation for Form 990, workers’ compensation audits, and other regulatory or audit requests.

Talent Management & Culture:
Coordinate full-cycle recruiting and onboarding activities, including posting jobs, scheduling interviews, preparing offer and onboarding materials, and supporting new hire setup.
Administer day-to-day talent management activities, including performance review administration, tracking development plans, supporting talent review meetings, and maintaining related documentation.
Work closely with managers to address day-to-day employee matters, reinforce workplace expectations, and support a positive and productive work environment.
Coordinate and support employee engagement, recognition, and retention activities, including communications, event planning, feedback collection, and follow-up actions.
Provide practical support to managers on employee development, team issues, and routine workplace concerns, and help ensure consistent follow-through on action items.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 7+ years of progressive human resources experience, including direct experience in benefits, payroll, compensation, and training and development.
Working knowledge of applicable federal, multi-state, and local employment laws and regulations.
Experience administering HRIS, payroll, and benefits systems.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy and attention to detail.

new_jobs.description:
About The Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About The Role

A highly organized and proactive People Operations Manager to build and scale the processes, systems, and programs that underpin our people experience. As a company operating in the rapidly evolving stablecoin and digital asset space, we move quickly while maintaining high standards of compliance, precision, and trust. The People Operations Manager will ensure our HR infrastructure is robust, efficient, and compliant across all regions in which we operate.

This role sits at the intersection of HR, legal, compliance, recruiting, payroll, and finance—requiring someone who is detail-oriented, tech-savvy, and comfortable working in a dynamic, regulated environment.

What You’ll Do

Own and optimize our HRIS, ATS, and people operations tools; drive automation and workflow improvements
Maintain accurate employee data, organizational charts, and reporting lines across all systems
Lead data integrity, auditing, and compliance efforts across HR platforms.
People Processes & Compliance
Develop, document, and maintain HR policies, handbooks, and SOPs across global jurisdictions
Ensure compliance with employment laws, financial regulatory requirements, and crypto-industry standards
Partner with Legal and Compliance to support onboarding, offboarding, and employee lifecycle changes
Manage background checks, employment verifications, and contractor compliance processes
International & Domestic Compensation, Payroll & Benefits Coordination
Collaborate with Finance and external payroll providers to ensure timely, accurate global payroll
Maintain records for variable compensation, token/equity grants, and other crypto-specific programs
Support annual compensation reviews, benefits renewals, and compensation benchmarking efforts
Employee Experience & Lifecycle Management
Manage onboarding workflows to ensure a smooth, compliant, and high-quality new-hire experience
Oversee offboarding, exit documentation, equipment logistics, and system access governance
Serve as the first point of contact for HR inquiries, troubleshooting and escalating as needed.
Reporting & Analytics
Build and maintain dashboards for headcount, attrition, diversity metrics, workforce planning, and more
Provide people data insights to leadership for strategic planning and audits

What we're looking for

5+ years of HR operations or people operations experience, ideally within fintech, crypto, or tech
Deep understanding of global HR compliance, employment laws, and payroll operations
Experience managing HR systems (e.g., Ashby, Notion, JustWorks)
Strong analytical mindset and comfort with spreadsheets, audits, and data integrity
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to scale processes in a fast-moving environment
Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, fintech, banking, crypto) strongly preferred
Discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive information

Nice to have, but not mandatory

Experience supporting teams across the US, LATAM, EU, or APAC
Familiarity with compensation structures unique to crypto (token grants, vesting schedules)
Background in startup environments or early-stage company scaling

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy, and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off
🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working
☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits
🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals
💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan
📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness
📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals
🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits
✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Compensation Range: $120K - $160K

Description & Requirements

Smurfit Westrock (NYSE:SW) is the go-to leader and partner of choice in sustainable packaging. We are dedicated to creating efficient and scalable paper and packaging solutions to help solve complex packaging challenges. Guided by our values of safety, loyalty, integrity and respect, we are committed to delivering meaningful value for shareholders, customers, employees and the communities where we operate.

The Sr. Manager, Talent Acquisition will be an essential leader within the Frontline Talent Acquisition team and will be responsible for leading recruitment efforts across the Corrugated Division to include Merchandising Display & Packaging Solutions. In this role, you will design and execute Frontline Talent Acquisition strategies that attract top hourly and Salary Non-Exempt talent and support organizational growth. You will partner closely with HR and business leaders to ensure alignment with workforce planning and deliver a world-class hiring manager and candidate experience. This position offers the opportunity to influence global recruiting practices, mentor teams, and drive impactful initiatives.

How You Will Impact Smurfit Westrock

Provide strategic leadership and direction to a team of recruiters, ensuring alignment with business objectives, operational excellence, and industry best practices.
Design, implement, and continuously optimize enterprise level recruiting strategies that accelerate hiring speed, elevate talent quality, strengthen workforce diversity, and enhance the end-to-end candidate experience.
Work in conjunction with peers and leadership to develop, implement, and continuously enhance standardized operating procedures for Talent Acquisition processes, while training and coaching team members to ensure consistent execution, compliance, and operational excellence.
Partner closely with HR Business Partners and senior business leaders to understand workforce planning needs and deliver proactive, data informed talent solutions.
Serve as a trusted external labor market expert, advising executives on talent supply trends, competitive intelligence, and sourcing strategies that support long term talent pipeline development.
Lead employer brand initiatives to position Smurfit WestRock as a top employer of choice across priority markets and talent segments.
Ensure full compliance with all employment laws, regulatory requirements, and internal policies across the recruiting lifecycle, mitigating risk and promoting equitable hiring practices.
Collaborate with TA Operations, HR Technology, and TA leadership to evaluate, implement, and optimize recruitment technologies, tools, and workflows that enhance efficiency and stakeholder engagement.
Leverage recruiting analytics and performance metrics to identify trends, diagnose challenges, and drive continuous improvement across processes, team performance, and hiring outcomes.
Influence and consult with senior stakeholders through data-driven recommendations, reinforcing Talent Acquisition best practices and enabling effective decision-making.
Oversee the full recruitment lifecycle for critical or executive-level roles, including intake strategy sessions, interview design, talent assessment, and post-interview debrief facilitation.
Lead or contribute to strategic initiatives and enterprise-wide projects aimed at strengthening Talent Acquisition capabilities, processes, and organizational readiness.

What You Need To Succeed

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, or related field.
10+ years of corporate recruiting or talent acquisition experience; leadership experience required.
Proven experience developing and leading recruitment strategies for high volume hourly and skilled trade roles, with strong preference for candidates with production and manufacturing environment experience.
Strong business acumen to build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with business leaders and HR Business Partners, serving as a strategic talent partner to align hiring strategies with business priorities and workforce needs.
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make strategic recommendations.
Exceptional communication and influencing skills to engage stakeholders and candidates.
Experience recruiting across multiple levels and functions (professional, technical, leadership).
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

What Smurfit Westrock Offers

Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
Retirement savings plans with company match.
Paid time off and holiday benefits.
Wellness programs and employee assistance resources.
Career development opportunities and leadership training.
Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability, and excellence.
A career with a global packaging leader where sustainability, safety, and inclusion are core values.
